definitionZh: 内置块启动 CSS 属性定义了一个元素的逻辑块启动抵消,该元素根据元素的写法模式,方向性,和文本方向,将它映射到物理设置中. 它与上,右,下,或左属性相对应,取决于为写法模式,方向,以及文字导向定义的值.
sourceDefinition: The inset-block-start CSS property defines the logical block start offset of an element, which maps to a physical inset depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top, right, bottom, or left property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
